summary.text: Ty Dressler is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives representing District 36 (Richardton), serving since 2025. His standing committees in the 2025 regular session are Finance and Taxation and Transportation.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, Dressler is an agricultural business owner and rancher with a BA in natural resources management from NDSU.
His biography lists past service on the Richardton-Taylor School Board and membership in the Richardton Lions Club.
In the interim he is vice chair of the Tax Reform and Relief Advisory Committee.
His biography lists him as married to Daneen, with three children.
